from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f1e670e8.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts)
    # isolated marker color is the rare single-color points; template is the dense multicolor object
    marker_color=min(cnt, key=lambda x:cnt[x])
    markers=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c]==marker_color]
    body=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c]!=marker_color]
    r0=min(r for r,c,v in body); r1=max(r for r,c,v in body)
    c0=min(c for r,c,v in body); c1=max(c for r,c,v in body)
    ar=(r0+r1)//2; ac=(c0+c1)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for mr,mc in markers:
        dr=mr-ar; dc=mc-ac
        for r,c,v in body:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)

for (r,c),v in vals.items():grid[r][c]=v
out=__import__('runpy').run_path(str(p))['transform'](grid)
